column8: ["Give the purple glaze richer pooled shadows and sharper, selective highlights so the broad housing feels fired and substantial.","Differentiate the dark seat collars from the brass fittings with matte rubber wear and small polished metallic edges.","Develop the central U-shaped fitting with clearer bevels, fastening details and localized tarnish; its broad dark outline currently overwhelms its material character."]

["Give the broad violet housing more decisive glaze highlights and deeper edge shadows so its ceramic mass feels substantial.","Differentiate the seat collars with clearer rubber lips, compressed edges and localized wear; their materials currently blend into the surrounding purple.","Sharpen the central brass fitting with brighter worn edges, darker recesses and distinct fasteners so its construction feels purposeful.","Vary the evenly mottled surface with quieter glazed areas and concentrated chips around contact points, giving the detailed painting stronger focal hierarchy."]

["Give the purple glaze clearer pools of shine and deeper recesses; its broadly even shading makes the substantial housing feel softer than ceramic.","Sharpen the brass U fitting with brighter worn edges, darker undersides and distinct attachment points so it feels convincingly mounted.","Differentiate the seat materials with compressed rubber lips, tarnished metal rims and localized glaze chips; the repeated rings currently feel too similar in finish."]

["Give the central brass mechanism clearer overlapping plates, sharper edges and deeper recesses so its construction reads more confidently.","Enrich the broad violet ceramic faces with pooled glaze, small chips and selective bright reflections to strengthen their material character.","Differentiate the dark rubber liners from the brass rims with softer highlights and localized compression or wear."]
